caption_L1: This area graph is titled Median weekly earnings of African American full-time wage and salary workers in the United States from 1979 to 2019 (in current U.S. dollars). caption_L2L3: The chart shows a steady increase in wages for African American workers over 40 years with only a couple of dips in the increase.
